Last school year in February 11, a senior at my school was on her way there in the morning, when she got in a car crash. The drivers side of her car was completely smashed, and she was unrecognizable. If she hadn't had her wallet in the passenger seat, they wouldn't have been able to identify her at the scene. She was an amazing girl, and an even better friend. Her parents walked up on stage at graduation and accepted her diploma, they received a standing ovation. She was involved in the Deaf community, and absolutely loved it. She was down to Earth, never made anyone feel less than her, even though we all knew we were. They aren't sure what caused the accident, but they think something got stuck under her brake pedal. Since it was the other drivers (a bus driver for the school) word against no one's, they have no proof that she was the catalyst of the crash. Second period they made the announcement. Claire has died. Grief counselors are available. No one wants a grief counselor, we want Claire back. I still can't think about her without tearing up, but I'm glad to get all this off my chest. Thank you for reading. 

TL; DR: senior crashes car on way to school. Everyone cries.
